comments.body:
**The example this ticket was filed against is being removed, which changes how the gap must be proven.**

`docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` was the concrete instance of an unguarded Compose `image:` key — `docker.io/minio/minio:latest`. It is being replaced with a pinned `quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z` under `stoppable-sorry-budgie` (6d98-28f4), because the Docker Hub repository no longer exists at all: the Hub API returns 404 `object not found` and a token-authed manifest request returns 401, which is what turned the scheduled `Live External Integration` run red.

That fix is unrelated to this gate and does not close it. It does mean a reviewer checking this ticket after 6d98 lands will find no floating tag in the tree and may read the gap as already fixed. It is not: `scripts/check_uv_pin.py:400` still globs `**/Dockerfile*` only, so no Compose `image:` key is guarded, and nothing prevents the next floating tag from being added.

**Consequence for this ticket's tests.** A regression test can no longer point at a live offender, so it needs a fixture Compose file with a deliberately floating tag and an assertion that the checker rejects it. That is the more durable shape anyway — a test that depends on a real file's staying broken would have started failing the moment 6d98 landed.

Worth noting that the repository was one `docker compose pull` away from this being invisible: every other image in that file — langfuse, clickhouse, redis, postgres — is pinned, so the single unpinned key was the outlier the guard was supposed to catch and structurally could not.

Cross-reference: `docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration-code-v5.md:107-110` cites this exact pair as its worked example of "a guard that exists but cannot fail". It is a dated experiment record, so it is deliberately left unedited and now describes a state the tree has moved past.

compiled_state.description:
## Symptom

`scripts/check_uv_pin.py` is the repository's image-pin gate: it rejects an image that resolves from a floating `:latest` tag, and it asserts that the uv image names the exact `[tool.uv] required-version`. It only ever reads Dockerfiles. Every `image:` key in every Compose file is outside the scanned set, so a floating tag there lands with no gate objection.

## Evidence from `origin/main`

- `_dockerfiles()` at `scripts/check_uv_pin.py:396-400` builds the entire scanned file set from a single glob: `root.glob("**/Dockerfile*")`.
- `check_dockerfiles()` at `:476-494` is the only image scanner in the script. It iterates `_dockerfiles(root)` and matches `DOCKERFILE_IMAGE_PATTERN` per line.
- `check_repo()` at `:495-504` composes the five checks — `check_pyproject`, `check_no_root_uv_toml`, `check_local_action`, `check_workflows`, `check_dockerfiles`. No Compose-aware check exists to compose.
- The gate's own failure text at `:515-524` states the rule as "Every Dockerfile must name …" and "no Dockerfile may resolve any image from a floating `:latest` tag", confirming the scope gap is in the design, not only the glob.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` carries 6 `image:` keys the gate never reads, at lines 25, 70, 92, 113, 133 and 149.
- Line 113 is `image: docker.io/minio/minio:latest` — a floating tag, which is precisely the class of reference the gate exists to reject. It reached `main` unchallenged and then broke: when the upstream `docker.io/minio/minio` repository became unavailable, the `Live External Integration` workflow went red on `main` with `pull access denied for minio/minio`. That is tracked as bug `6d98-28f4-946a-4016`, whose fix repins that one line.

This ticket is the class fix behind that instance: `6d98` removes the floating tag, and this ticket removes the blind spot that let it exist.

## Scope of the blast radius today

The repository contains 3 Compose files:

- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` — 6 `image:` keys, listed above.
- `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` — every service uses `build:`; it has no `image:` key.
- `tests/external/live_jira_dc/docker-compose.yml` — the single service uses `build: .`; it has no `image:` key.

So the gate extension changes the verdict for exactly one file. After `6d98` repins line 113, the remaining 5 references are `clickhouse-server:24.3` (exact), `redis:7` (exact), and 3 that interpolate with a literal default — `${LANGFUSE_IMAGE_TAG:-3.186.0}` twice and `${POSTGRES_VERSION:-17}` once. Each resolves to an exact tag, so the extended gate reports zero findings on a tree that already carries `6d98`'s fix. This ticket therefore depends on `6d98` landing first; it is already linked `discovered_from` it.

## Design

Add a Compose scanner that reuses the existing per-reference rule rather than restating it.

1. Add `_compose_files(root)`, mirroring `_dockerfiles()`: glob `**/docker-compose*.yml`, `**/docker-compose*.yaml`, `**/compose*.yml` and `**/compose*.yaml`, apply the same `{".git", ".venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__"}` skip set, and return a sorted deduplicated list.
2. Add `COMPOSE_IMAGE_PATTERN`, an anchored line pattern for `^\s*image:\s*(?P<image>\S+)\s*$` that also tolerates a quoted value and a trailing `#` comment. Compose uses the `image:` key only inside a service block, so a line match is sufficient and — unlike `yaml.safe_load` — it preserves the line number the `Finding` location format needs.
3. Add `check_compose_images(root)`, structured exactly like `check_dockerfiles()`: for each file, for each matching line, resolve the reference and delegate the verdict.
4. Resolve Compose interpolation before judging. A `${VAR:-default}` form carries its pin as a literal in the file, so substitute the default and judge the result; that is what makes the gate able to read 3 of the 6 references on `main` instead of skipping them. A defaultless `${VAR}` names no provable tag and is a finding. Neither form exists as a violation on `main` today, so this rule adds no new failure to the current tree.
5. Delegate the per-reference verdict to the existing `_check_dockerfile_reference()`, renamed `_check_image_reference()` with its callers updated. Its body is already reference-generic: it rejects a missing tag, rejects `:latest`, passes through non-uv images, and applies `_check_uv_reference` to the uv image. Renaming keeps one rule for both file kinds rather than a second copy that can drift.
6. Add `check_compose_images(root)` to the tuple returned by `check_repo()`.
7. Update the gate's failure epilogue at `:515-524` so it states the rule over both file kinds instead of Dockerfiles alone.

Keep each new function small. The complexity ratchet records a symbol only once it exceeds the `max-complexity = 15` ceiling, and the shape above keeps every new function well under it.

## Mechanism-delta note

This adds no new mechanism of any censused kind. It introduces no lock, env var, config key, feature flag, autouse fixture or test helper, and it adds no new CI gate: `check_uv_pin.py` is already wired into `make lint` at `Makefile:439` and already runs on every commit and in CI. This widens an existing gate's input set.

## Portability

The scanner is stdlib-only and runs inside `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` from the `lint` target, exactly as the Dockerfile scan does today. It needs no CI provider, no registry network access and no Docker daemon — it reads files. A checkout with no CI at all gets the same verdict from `make lint`. This matches the portability contract the surrounding gates already state at `Makefile:437-438`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` defines `_compose_files()`, which returns Compose files under the repo root and excludes `.git`, `.venv`, `node_modules` and `__pycache__`.
- [ ] `_compose_files()` returns `docker-compose.langfuse.yml`, `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` and `tests/external/live_jira_dc/docker-compose.yml` for this repository, with no duplicates.
- [ ] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` defines `check_compose_images()`.
- [ ] `check_repo()` includes `check_compose_images()` in the checks it composes.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value naming a bare repository with no tag and no digest produces a finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value whose tag is `latest` produces a finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value with an exact tag produces no finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value with a bare digest and no tag produces no finding for a non-uv image.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value of the form `${VAR:-1.2.3}` is judged on the literal default and produces no finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value of the form `${VAR:-latest}` produces a finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value of the form `${VAR}` with no default produces a finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value naming the uv image with a tag other than `[tool.uv] required-version` produces a finding.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` value naming the uv image by digest alone produces a finding.
- [ ] Each Compose finding's location names the Compose file path and the 1-based line number of the offending `image:` line.
- [ ] `_check_dockerfile_reference` is renamed `_check_image_reference` and every call site is updated.
- [ ] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` contains no second copy of the floating-tag rule.
- [ ] The gate's failure epilogue text states that the pin rule covers Compose `image:` keys as well as Dockerfiles.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the no-tag Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the `:latest` Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the exact-tag Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the `${VAR:-1.2.3}` Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the `${VAR:-latest}` Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers the defaultless `${VAR}` Compose case.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` covers a uv-image Compose reference whose tag disagrees with `required-version`.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` asserts the reported line number for at least one Compose finding.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` reports no finding against this repository's own tree.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` exits 0.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0.

## Testing

During development, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py -q`. Each Compose case builds a temporary root with a `pyproject.toml` carrying a known `[tool.uv] required-version` plus one Compose file, matching the fixture style the existing Dockerfile cases use. Then run `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` against the real checkout to confirm the widened gate is clean on `main`, and finally `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` before pushing.

## Source

Discovered while fixing `6d98-28f4-946a-4016`, where a floating `docker.io/minio/minio:latest` in `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` broke `Live External Integration` on `main`. The instance fix repins that one line; this ticket closes the gap that allowed a floating tag into a Compose file at all.
compiled_state.title: Image-pin gate only globs Dockerfile*, leaving every Compose image: key unguarded
